# Latvian Association of Darwin Inc (Dārvinas Latviešu Apvienība)

> The Latvian Association of Darwin Inc is a community organization in Darwin, Northern Territory, Australia, dedicated to preserving and sharing Latvian culture, heritage, language, and community connections in the Top End.

## Overview
- **Organization Name**: Latvian Association of Darwin Inc (Dārvinas Latviešu Apvienība)
- **Location**: Darwin, Northern Territory, Australia
- **ABN**: 25 545 712 911
- **Incorporation Date**: 22 October 2023
- **Contact Email**: hello@latviansofdarwin.org.au / support@latviansofdarwin.org.au
- **Official Website**: https://latviansofdarwin.org.au

## Primary Pages & Documentation
- [/en](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en): English Homepage & Overview
- [/lv](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/lv): Latvian Homepage & Overview
- [/en/history](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/history): History of Latvians in Northern Territory & Darwin since the 1980s
- [/en/community](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/community): Community activities, gatherings & cultural projects in the Top End
- [/en/membership](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/membership): Join the association, membership details & benefits
- [/en/culture](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/culture): Latvian traditions, midsummer Jāņi celebrations & heritage
- [/en/events](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/events): Upcoming & past cultural events (18. novembris, Jāņi, Lieldienas, Baltic Way)
- [/en/donate](https://latviansofdarwin.org.au/en/donate): Support association projects and cultural preservation

## Key Information
Founded by Latvian migrants and community members in Darwin, the Association fosters cultural heritage, language preservation, community celebrations, and intercultural partnerships with Aboriginal and local Top End communities.
